about: Golden cases plugsmith must get right. Each case is a tiny repository. Built cases run plugsmith first; hand-written cases check plugin files someone wrote. 'valid' follows Claude Code's plugin and marketplace references and what claude plugin validate said on 2026-10-19 (Claude Code 2.1.304). plugsmith's static check must agree on every case, and claude must agree whenever it is on PATH, except where a case sets 'claude_check': 'skip' with the reason.
